_help: Frames that are one photograph: re-edits of the same shot (colour and black and white, a different grade, a double exposure) or the same file listed twice. Each group is one tile in the gallery. The first stem is the edit the tile shows; the others come up while the tile is hovered and in the lightbox's Edit buttons (gallery.js). Every stem must be in photography-files.json, and in one group only (audit: photo-variants).
